Lightfoot Journal

CY 843

Jimmel Lightfoot 24 = 819 AC

Lumiel Lightfoot - Mother elven – 400 yr = 409 AC

Camus & Sarya Lightfoot - GrandParents - -400 = 009 AC

Filverl & Syllia Lightfoot - Great Grand Parents – 500 = -491 BC

Journal of Filverl Lightfoot

Date: 350 years Before Cataclysm

- I met the most interesting young man today. He hailed from a land to
the far west and told me of many great tales. He said his name was
Brother Salla, from the land of the Star. We welcomed him in from his
travels and gave him leave to stay for a bit.

345 yr BC

- It is time for another unfortunate culling. The Glades have been
rather fruitful these last few years and have exceeded their population
quota. I have ordered another round of barges to be constructed to
transport the workers to the Pale Lake. It is called the Pale Lake due
to the reflection of the snow capped Bone Mountains, although we refer
to it’s nickname, Gravestone, as it is the final resting place of the
excess population of the Glades.

- 343 yr BC

Brother Salla has returned for another visit, bringing good tidings.
Aware of our issue of excess people he had a most interesting proposal.
He mentioned a people known as the Arnieans to the south, who might
provide a profitable avenue for our excess population. I agreed to send
an envoy, my son Camus, with his people on a voyage to see what might
become of it.

-342 yr BC

Brother Salla proposed a venture that we might embark upon to eliminate
the need for the distasteful need to eliminate excess population.
Apparently he has knowledge of efforts to create men of metal. He thinks
that these metal men, if properly animated, might be able to be our
workers and soldiers, freeing us from our need to keep the Glades. It
was not all that long ago that we had to fight off another major Goblin
incursion from the North. We did find their tunnel and collapse it, but
not without great cost. Without the glades, or a suitable replacement,
the Elvish birthrate will not sustain the numbers needed to fight off
the hordes of the north, not to mention the Dwarves out to the west whom
we must keep an eye on.

I sent an envoy with Brother Salla on his last trip back home to the
Star lands. It seems to be just another Human kingdom that springs up
like a perennial weed in the ruins of another, older civilization. There
is some potential there, but they are busy squabbling amongst each other
and likely don’t realize what they have.

- 341 yr BC

Camus returned from the Arniean trip. It seems that the Arnieans are in
need of good workers and are very eager to take on our surplus. They are
willing to pay quite handsomely for a quantity of good workers. I will
bring this up with the other Houses at the next Gathering.

- 338 yr BC

The Gathering was amenable to the idea of delivering the excess to the
Arnieans, much more palatable and less wasteful than sending them to the
bottom of Gravestone Lake. Aptly named indeed for the countless souls
who call those waters their final home. The Council has commissioned
transports to deliver the excess to the Arnieans. As a bonus, this
agreement has reduced the effect of piracy on our fleets. Apparently,
piracy is a hobby of some of the Arniean clans, but they have apparently
been brought to heel to leave our ships unmolested. It has been sometime
since we have gotten a trade convoy through to Castlemarch by sea.

- 325 yr BC

Brother Salla has returned to us once more, but I fear this will be his
last visit as he is an old man now. He did bring a young Sister Rasha
with him, who is his protégé. We have sent several transports to the
Arnieans. With the extra wealth in hand, I have agreed to fund the
effort to make the metal men.

-275 yr BC

Construction on the laboratory is nearly complete. There were some
natural caves to the north east that we were able to expand and with the
help of Sister Salla, make into a suitable research facility to continue
the efforts. The initial efforts have been rudimentary at best. We are
working to recruit more capable artisans. However, it is somewhat
difficult to recruit the talent, due to the secrecy of the project. It
has the potential to revolutionize the world. I am pleased to see Camus
taking quite the interest in the project.

- 270 yr BC

I’ve turned over the metal men project to Camus, as I’ve decided to
relocate to Yemthas to attend to matters between the Houses. Sister Mira
arrived today as Sister Salla’s replacement. It seems Camus has taken a
fancy to her. The poor humans, their lives go by so quickly. It’s a
wonder they accomplish what they do. They have crafted several
prototypes, but as yet have not achieved any form of animation that is
worthwhile.
